title: ParsedDoc
description: Common output schema for every parser in Eoditdeora. All parsers MUST emit this shape regardless of source format.

doc_id.description: SHA-256 content hash of the original file. Stable across renames.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the original file. POSIX-style internally (converted from Windows \\ on collection).

source_path_display.description: OS-native path string for UI display (Windows uses backslashes).

parser.description: Identifier of the parser implementation that produced this output (e.g., 'hwpx_native', 'pyhwp', 'pypdfium2').

fidelity.description: Self-reported parse fidelity: 1=filename only, 5=lossless structural + semantic.

blocks.description: Ordered content blocks of the document. Preserve reading order.

images.description: Embedded images extracted from the doc.

metadata.description: Document-level metadata extracted from the file (author, dates, application, etc.)

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered during parsing. Surface to user so they can understand missing content.

parse_ms.description: Wall-clock ms spent parsing. Used for perf telemetry (local only).

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) where this block appears. Null for formats without pages.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] bounding box in source coordinates. Used for UI highlight.

meta.description: Free-form block metadata (e.g., table row/col dimensions, list marker style).

cache_path.description: Absolute path to extracted image in local thumbnail cache.

caption.description: VLM-generated caption; populated by Understander stage, not parser.
